---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a new rule, primitive, or capability
labels: enhancement
---

## What would you like to see

A clear description of the feature or rule you'd like added.

## Why

What problem does it solve? What pain are you (or your team) hitting today?

## Suggested approach

If you have one — what's your idea for how it should work? (Skip if you'd
rather just describe the problem.)

## Alternatives considered

Any workarounds you've tried, or other tools that solve this differently?
